decode_sample_from_tar: decode a sample dict from a BOP webdataset shard into image data with camera, RGB, depth, and ground truth
load_image_data_from_shard: load image data for a given image key from a BOP webdataset tar shard file
decode_sample_with_depth_rescaling: decode a webdataset sample and rescale depth values using the camera depth scale factor
load_image_data_with_masks: load image data from a tar shard including visible masks and ground truth masks for specified instance IDs
decode_sample_selective_fields: decode only selected fields like camera and RGB from a webdataset sample by toggling decode flags
